title: Average conditional count of affected constraints
statement: Let $D$ be a finite set, let a constraint template on $D$ specify a finite family of predicates with arities and Boolean evaluations, and let $P$ be a finite set of variables. Suppose a constraint instance on $P$ has a nonempty multiset of constraints and every variable in $P$ occurs in some constraint scope. Given a probability distribution on $D$ for each variable and a variable $v\in P$, the expectation, with $v$ sampled from its given distribution, of the sum of expected satisfaction indicators for constraints containing $v$, when the marginal at $v$ is replaced by a point mass at the sampled label, equals the sum of the original expected satisfaction indicators over those constraints.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint template on $D$ is given
The constraint instance has a nonempty constraint multiset
Every variable in $P$ occurs in some constraint scope
A probability distribution on $D$ is assigned to each variable
